Since $s_i=\tau r_i$ there, $\theta_r=\theta_s/\tau$ and their diffusion coefficients satisfy $D_r=D_s/\tau^2$. Their units differ, so their numerical values should not be compared without this conversion. A population can also emit several spikes within one update.
